Finger of the Council

The first cutoff that contains the Finger’s hidden 1–100 roll picks another piece of the same set.

Odds and worked example

Example: Finger + Civerb's Icon gives Civerb's Ward at rolls 1–50 (≤ 50). The original piece cannot return. Rounding can give other sets slightly unequal shares.

Pieces in the setCutoffs, in recipe orderChance per other piece

Eye of Reckoning

The Eye remakes the same unique or set item on the same base, with fresh stat rolls at the input item level. An ethereal unique stays ethereal. Sockets reset.

Odds and worked example

Example: The Gnasher rolls +60–70% enhanced damage: 11 integer values, each with a 1/11 chance. A fresh roll can equal or fall below the old value. Fixed stats stay fixed.

Horn of Delving

Sockets = min(an even roll from 1 to 6, the item’s socket maximum).

Odds and worked example

Example: A Gothic Plate at item level 99 holds 4 sockets. Rolls 4–6 all become 4 sockets, so the maximum has a 3/6 chance.

Gothic Plate at item level 99Raw socket rollsChance
1 socket11/6 = 16.67%
2 sockets21/6 = 16.67%
3 sockets31/6 = 16.67%
4 sockets4 / 5 / 63/6 = 50.00%

The base, item level and item type limit the maximum. Each result after the cap does not have equal odds.

Oils

An oil and a Perfect Gem pick the guaranteed stat. Golden Oil chooses the class by the listed weights when you transmute.

Odds and worked example

Example: Golden Oil + Perfect Ruby + Jawbone of Lies + magic Amulet can give +3 to Fire Skills (Sorceress Only) (17%). All 6 listed classes can roll, regardless of your character’s class.

2-way: Golden Oil + Perfect Emerald + Amulet

+3 to Demon Skills (Warlock Only)33%

These tables describe the guaranteed line, alongside the item’s other random affixes. The oil’s hidden roll and stacking do not choose the class. Oil crafting lists every gem and equipment combination.

Soul of Legend

Cube one Soul with normal or superior unsocketed equipment, or a magic ring or amulet. One transmute gives a unique of that slot. There is no hidden Soul roll and no separate chase pile. Corrupted items are refused.

Level bands and exact odds

Your character level selects the band. The output item level is the band’s lower limit, so its pool and odds stay fixed throughout the band. Ordinary uniques unlock at most four character levels late. Restricted-source candidates can unlock later. Below a slot’s first band, both inputs stay in the cube; nothing is consumed.

The game chooses each eligible base equally, then chooses an eligible unique on that base by rarity. An item’s exact chance per Soul is 1 ÷ eligible bases × rarity share. Expanded: 1 / bases × its rarity / total rarity on its base. There is always an eligible unique on every selected base; no recipe forces a rare.

Example: At character levels 86–99, a helm draw has 41 eligible bases. Harlequin Crest has rarity 1 out of 1 on its Shako base. Its chance is 1/41 × 1/1 = 1/41 (2.43902%) per Soul.

The Horn needs an unsocketed helm, body armour, shield, weapon, gloves, boots, belt or ring of any quality.

Repair low-quality equipment before using the Soul, Quill or oils. Cube a low-quality weapon with an Eld Rune and a Chipped Gem. For armour, use an El Rune and a Chipped Gem.
